title: 3. Dreams that build the readable hierarchy

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: A dream should keep the information hierarchy in shape: overviews rewritten, new records given a place, nothing lost, without the structure rearranging itself.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: The owner, 2026-10-30: the dreamtime is "Building the human readable overview, refining the information hierarchy so that our information has places to go and is not lost." 2026-10-26 (29d4cbd4): coherence "probably only emerges from a synthesis – a dreamtime process". 2026-10-27 (ac5974c6): a settled navigation should "evolve in a consistent manner automatically, with only significant redesigns coming up for PR". This joins the human-readable repositories thread (part 4, structure that stays stable) and the research practice of rewriting overviews rather than appending to them.
